newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill starts Budimex with accumulate.
newsitem.headline: Merrill starts Budimex with accumulate.

text.p: Merrill Lynch of London initiated its coverage of Polish construction and trading company Budimex SA with an accumulate rating saying the stock was the most undervalued of large-cap firms in the sector.
It said in its monthly European emerging markets report dated April 9 the company should also benefit from its participation in Poland's motorway construction programme.
"Budimex is well positioned to benefit from the accelerating growth in infrastructure construction," it said.
On April 2 Budimex closed at 26.10 zlotys and on Friday the stock closed at 28.5 zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
